description: This file defines interfaces and serializable classes related to circular state management in Orleans grains, including the interface for a grain with a method to get its state and classes representing the state with circular references.

classes.name: CircularStateTestState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the grain's state, containing a reference to CircularTest1 object.

classes.name: CircularTest1
classes.description: Serializable class with a reference to CircularTest2, forming part of the circular reference structure.

classes.name: CircularTest2
classes.description: Serializable class containing a list of CircularTest1 objects, completing the circular reference cycle.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Method of ICircularStateTestGrain that returns the current state encapsulated in CircularTest1.
